criteria.criterion: All 19 N plus 27 E IT groups must form connected complete units including endings. All 473 native rows and twelve fields remain preserved; every assigned exact whole receives the same entry at every occurrence, even when blocked. S/W/.1/.24 may remain UNKNOWN but cannot hide assigned counteruses. Alternate replays preserve literal uncertainty and are not independent evidence.

Separate world predicates from immutable records, named kinds, instruction outputs and constructor truths. Identify the owner, physical participant versus kind, property or relation, observer-relative reference, time and condition of each claim. A conditional physics statement can be substantive without an actual storm. Stipulating a predicate name or obtaining a well-typed record does not demonstrate its truth in the manuscript.

Where suppression claims a survivor, its actual consumer must retain the stronger original participant and distinguish that identity from a newly introduced same-kind participant. Where succession is claimed, distinguish cessation of u from generation of v, v unequal to u, causal relation, ordered times and adjacent directions in a retained frame. Adjacency is neither absolute cardinal naming nor qualitative opposition. A fresh-ID constructor alone is authored semantics, not an observed origin. No generic naming or kind equality supplies lineage.

At least two licensed exact forms among bare aiin/daiin/shodaiin must actually execute the same non-null interface, with typed arguments, outputs and written consumers. Bare aiin remains a root; separately chosen payloads and whole-template reuse are visible costs, not evidence of identical predicate meaning or a universal morpheme. Record freezing can be an admissible C0 operation, but its effects and argument binding must be distinguished from redundant assertions already in the initial state.

Producer and consumer IDs may document actual written dependencies; they cannot serve as per-occurrence semantic exceptions or magically choose an otherwise free operand. Audit every exact recurrence, including or shedy tedy sodaiiin chy in IT/ZL and the distinct RF spelling. Missing typed operands, incompatible types, contradictory world assertions, unknown constructors and mere unfinished scope are separate findings. Paid continuity across UNKNOWN rows remains an assumption, with intervening rows counted, rather than a derived bridge. Unexecuted instructions do not change the world.

C may assert substantial generic conditional physics, causes and changing properties. A and B may contain both mechanisms when transitions are written and paid. A fair static formulation can encode two indexed states plus paid identity, order and cause/comparison relations; a dynamic interface has no automatic informational advantage. Do not install this bridge into a frozen author account. Do not require an invented OriginalOnly tail, a fixed historical branch, rare daiin name, or confirmed lexical anchor.

For each complete fixed account, specify one same-world counterfactual and the actual nonseed written IDs whose predicates or bindings constrain it. Compare unequal opposed participants with original stronger survivor; cessation followed by a distinct adjacent successor; and generic kind-level rules without episode identity. Match shared frame, strength, conditions and times where the accounts actually bind them. If a fixed narrative encodes both mechanisms, evaluate its joint consequences rather than force exclusivity. Swapping same-kind IDs tests identity only if consumed; consistent renaming of types, participants, ports and directions tests equivalence, not falsification.

Report initial core families/constants and additional exact wholes, payloads, rules, aliases, defaults, initial premises, ambient holders, ordering, time/scope/reference bridges and unused instructions separately. Unweighted economy is descriptive without a calibrated semantic model comparison. A contradiction closes that frozen candidate; partial rivals do not select a complete rival. Coherent complete rival stories may remain meaning-equivalent. This is exploratory C0, zero independent meaning confirmation and no significance or semantic winner.
